definition: COSFIRE stands for Combination Of Shifted FIlter REsponses.
details: COSFIRE is a trainable filter, which can be used for interest point (keypoint) detection and pattern recognition in the field of computer vision.
story: Picture walking through a crowd and instantly picking out a familiar face without reading a single name tag. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. Sight, for a machine, is a long climb from raw light to a name. That pixel-to-meaning climb is COSFIRE.
